comment: Fit puts the painting between the docker columns. With the dockers kept floating, so every docker is a side cover of the view and Fit to View, Centre View and the boot's fit place the document in the free rectangle between them, while View > Fit to Window, the new row under Fit to View, fits the whole visible rectangle as Fit did before. The window is 1920 by 1080 on the Default layout, and the twin of this file runs the same steps at 1280 by 1024. A checker of 128 marks the document's edges. Nothing is saved.

00, the boot's fit. Nothing has been pressed, so the hold still fits the document into what the bar, the status line and the dockers leave: the whole document between the left column, which ends at 380, and the right one, which starts at 1600.
01, Tab hides the dockers and View > Fit to View fits again. With no docker shown the free rectangle is the visible one, so the document spreads across the window.
02, Tab brings the dockers back, and Fit to View puts the document between them again.
03, View > Fit to Window with the dockers shown: the document across the whole window, under the columns, the fit Fit to View made before this row.

04, the Useful layout opens the Info docker beside the left column, 500 wide. Fit to View skips it, because it floats away from the window's edges and counting it would leave the painting less than half the window, so the document stands between the columns and partly under the Info docker.
05, the Full layout adds the Recorder, the Graph and the History in the middle, and Fit to View skips them as well.
